notes: Kett "Nest Reactor" (+1 power per Kett in the room): a round chitin dome of overlapping plates grown over an amber egg-core that pulses (4 frames), six hive cells round the rim that light green in turn, four corner drone bays with a drone in each. Damaged: a dome plate peeled back with light leaking, two rim cells dark, a bay door hanging, the core stutters. Disabled: the plates grey and cracked, the core a dull husk, cells dead, a bay broken.
